test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A speed of 16 km/h is the same as:(Up to 1 place of decimal)
solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 16 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Speed (m/sec) = Speed (km/h) × (1000 / 3600)

**Calculation:**

Convert 16 km/h to m/sec:

Speed (m/sec) = 16 × (1000 / 3600)

⇒ Speed (m/sec) = 16 × (10 / 36)

⇒ Speed (m/sec) = (160 / 36)

⇒ Speed (m/sec) = 4.4 m/sec

**The correct answer is 4.4 m/sec.**
